title: Truthful AI: Developing and governing AI that does not lie
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to the ethical and normative standard of truthfulness in AI. It proposes a framework for defining 'honesty' and 'truthfulness' as moral and legal requirements for AI systems, and discusses the ethical implications of AI-driven deception and the governance of information integrity. It does not merely include an ethics section but treats ethics and epistemology as its central subject matter.
